news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹31.00 (down from ₹47.89 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹27.8b (up 14% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹3.26b (down 35% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 12% (down from 21% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.7%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 7.5%. Revenue is forecast to grow 28% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 2.9% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India.

news.title: JSFB: Governance Meetings And Stable Assumptions Will Support Balanced Future Outlook
news.body: Analysts have kept the price target for Jana Small Finance Bank steady at ₹490, citing only minor tweaks to the discount rate and forward P/E assumptions rather than any major shift in the core earnings outlook. news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 19%
news.body: After last week's 19% share price gain to ₹469, the stock trades at a forward P/E ratio of 9x. Average forward P/E is 11x in the Banks industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 9.0% over the past year. Simply Wall St's valuation model estimates the intrinsic value at ₹408 per share.

news.body: Analysts have kept the fair value estimate for Jana Small Finance Bank steady at ₹490, with only marginal tweaks to inputs such as the discount rate and future P/E assumptions driving this unchanged price target. news.title: JSFB: Upcoming Results And Shareholder Actions Will Support Bullish Re Rating
news.body: Analysts have reiterated a price target of ₹490 for Jana Small Finance Bank, with the unchanged figure reflecting broadly similar fair value estimates supported by minor tweaks to the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E assumptions. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for Feb 06, 2026 at 12:30 Indian Standard Time to consider and approve unaudited financial results for the quarter ended Dec 31, 2025, along with other business matters (Key Developments).

news.title: JSFB: Steady Model Assumptions Will Support Upcoming Quarterly Results Outlook
news.body: Analysts have kept their price target for Jana Small Finance Bank steady at ₹490, with only very minor tweaks to inputs such as discount rate and future P/E assumptions. This reflects broadly unchanged views on the bank's risk profile and earnings potential.

news.title: High number of new directors
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. Additional Independent Director Pankaj Razdan was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2026. The company’s lack of board continuity is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: JSFB: Upcoming Quarterly Results Will Support Stronger Profit Outlook
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target for Jana Small Finance Bank from ₹495 to ₹490, reflecting slightly adjusted assumptions on growth, profitability and future P/E, while keeping the overall investment case broadly intact. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for February 6, 2026, at 12:30 Indian Standard Time to consider and approve the unaudited financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025, along with other business matters (Key Developments).

news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 36%
news.body: The consensus outlook for earnings per share (EPS) in fiscal year 2026 has deteriorated. 2026 revenue forecast decreased from ₹36.5b to ₹35.6b. EPS estimate also fell from ₹45.20 per share to ₹28.75 per share. Net income forecast to grow 85% next year vs 17% growth forecast for Banks industry in India. Consensus price target down from ₹545 to ₹490. Share price rose 10% to ₹388 over the past week.

news.title: JSFB: Higher Revenue Outlook And Upcoming Results Will Support Bullish Repricing
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target for Jana Small Finance Bank from ₹545 to ₹495. This reflects updated views on revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E expectations.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.92 (vs ₹10.57 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.92 (down from ₹10.57 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹6.43b (up 7.8% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹96.9m (down 91% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.5% (down from 19% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 24% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 2.8% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India.
